sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Phone Case DIY 2 - Casetify Game lies its creative engine, where players can design and customize their phone cases using a wide variety of colors, stickers, and patterns. The game's three making processes, Stencil art, Pop it, and Spray, offer distinct creative experiences that cater to different player preferences. Stencil art allows players to spray patterns onto their phone case using various stencils, while Pop it provides a fun and interactive experience where players can pop and arrange stickers on their design. Spray is a more traditional design process where players can use colors and patterns to create their desired design.

Each making process has its unique set of tools and materials, allowing players to experiment and find their preferred creative workflow. Players can switch between making processes at any time, allowing them to try out different approaches and techniques. The game's creative engine is highly responsive, with smooth animations and realistic physics that make the design process feel immersive and engaging.

As players progress through the game, they will unlock new colors, stickers, and patterns, providing endless creative possibilities. The game's level system also rewards players with experience points and badges, motivating them to continue designing and improving their skills.
